major.name: Floored
major.card: knocked Prone and can't stand up

offensive.name: Overwhelming Force
offensive.description: Some things do not ask to be resisted — converting damage to pure force that ignores resistance, then immunity, then every form of mitigation until it simply arrives and cannot be stopped.

tiers.text: The effect deals its damage as pure force damage regardless of its original type. It ignores resistance to the original damage type.
tiers.card: All damage becomes pure force and ignores the original type's resistance

tiers.text: The effect now ignores immunity to the original damage type: against it, immunity counts only as resistance.
tiers.card: Immunity counts only as resistance against it

tiers.text: The force cannot be reduced by any means — damage reduction features, the Shield spell, and similar effects do not apply.
tiers.card: The force can't be reduced by anything — no Shield, no damage reduction

tiers.text: Once per long rest, double all damage dice. The effect cannot be counterspelled, absorbed, or redirected by any means. It simply arrives.
tiers.card: 1/long rest double all damage dice · cannot be counterspelled, absorbed or redirected. It simply arrives

offensive.name: Rampage
offensive.description: Power does not peak — it escalates, each hit stacking bonus force damage until Rampage State maximizes every die and your momentum becomes physically impossible to withstand.

tiers.text: Each time this effect deals damage to a creature during this combat, the next instance of damage from this effect gains +1d8 bonus force damage, stacking up to 3 times. The stack resets if you do not deal damage with this effect for 2 consecutive rounds.
tiers.card: Each hit this combat adds +1d8 force to the next, stacking 3 times · resets if you deal none

tiers.text: The stack limit increases to 5 times, and at maximum stacks you ignore resistance to the effect's damage type. The bonus die increases to +1d10.
tiers.card: Stacks to 5 · +1d10 · at max you ignore resistance

tiers.text: The stack limit increases to 7 times, and at maximum stacks immunity counts only as resistance against you. Stacks no longer reset between rounds — only between combats.
tiers.card: Stacks to 7 · at max immunity counts only as resistance · stacks only reset between combats

tiers.text: At maximum stacks the effect reaches Rampage State — for 1 minute your damage with this effect is maximized, you cannot be reduced below 1 HP by damage from creatures you have already hit this combat, and each hit pushes the target 10 feet as the momentum of your strikes becomes physically overwhelming.
tiers.card: At max: Rampage State 1 min — maximised damage, and nothing you've already hit can drop you below 1 HP

supportive.name: Sovereign Aura
supportive.description: Power does not ask to be felt — it radiates outward as a Declaration of Sovereignty, bolstering allies and pressing enemies into difficult terrain and fear.

tiers.text: For 1 minute, allies within 15 feet gain +1 to attack rolls, and enemies that start their turn within 15 feet must succeed on a Strength save or have disadvantage on their first attack roll that turn.
tiers.card: 1 min: allies within 15 ft +1 attack · enemies starting there Str save or disadvantage on their first attack

penalty.disadvantage: their first attack roll that turn

tiers.text: The radius increases to 30 feet. The bonus to allies increases to +2, and enemies that fail their save also have their movement speed reduced by 10 feet for that turn.
tiers.card: 30 ft · allies +2 · failures also lose 10 ft speed that turn

tiers.text: Allies within range additionally gain +2 to saving throws, and enemies that fail are also unable to take reactions until the start of their next turn.
tiers.card: Allies also +2 to saves · failures can't take reactions

tiers.text: The aura becomes a Declaration of Sovereignty for 1 minute. Allies within range gain advantage on all attack rolls and saving throws. Enemies that fail their save are Frightened for 1 round and treat the entire aura radius as difficult terrain.
tiers.card: Declaration of Sovereignty 1 min — allies get advantage on everything, failures are Frightened

buff.advantage: all attack rolls and saving throws

control.name: Commanding Presence
control.description: Your authority alone reshapes action — stripping reactions, imposing fear, and eventually issuing a Battle Mandate that forces compliance or punishes defiance with psychic devastation.

tiers.text: Force one creature to make a Strength save or be unable to take reactions until the start of their next turn.
tiers.card: Str save or no reactions until the start of their next turn

tiers.text: The affected creature also suffers disadvantage on attack rolls against any creature other than you for 1 round.
tiers.card: Also disadvantage attacking anyone but you, 1 round

penalty.disadvantage: attack rolls against any creature other than you f

tiers.text: Creatures that fail are Frightened of you for 1 minute and must include you as a valid target if they choose to attack on their next turn.
tiers.card: Failures are Frightened of you 1 min and must include you as a target if they attack

tiers.text: Issue a Battle Mandate — one word of command ("Kneel", "Flee", "Stop"). A creature that fails the save must comply on their next turn or suffer 6d10 psychic damage and lose their action. On a success they resist the mandate but are still Frightened for 1 round.
tiers.card: Battle Mandate — one word. Fail and they obey or take 6d10 psychic and lose their action

control.name: Crushing Weight
control.description: The pressure of true power does not strike — it presses down, halving speed, stacking attack and save penalties, and eventually Restraining and Stunning the target as the weight becomes overwhelming.

tiers.text: On a failed save, the target's movement speed is halved and they have disadvantage on Strength checks until the end of their next turn.
tiers.card: Fail: speed halved and disadvantage on Str checks until end of their next turn

penalty.disadvantage: Strength checks until the end of their next turn

tiers.text: The target also suffers −2 to all attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute. Repeat Strength save at end of each turn to end early.
tiers.card: Also −2 to all attacks and saves 1 min (Str save each turn to end)

tiers.text: The penalty increases to −4, their speed is reduced to 0 until the end of their first turn, and they cannot benefit from features that increase their movement speed for the duration.
tiers.card: −4 · speed to 0 through their first turn · no speed-boosting features

tiers.text: The target is Restrained and Stunned until the end of their next turn as the weight becomes overwhelming. After that, the −4 penalty and speed reduction persist for 1 minute with no repeat save.
tiers.card: Restrained and Stunned until end of their next turn, then −4 and slowed for 1 min with no save

utility.name: Sheer Force
utility.description: It did not find the clever path around the mountain. It decided the mountain was in the way.

tiers.text: Lift, drag, or hold what ten strong people could. Break a nonmagical door, chain, lock, or wall by touch. Be heard clearly by everyone within 300 feet.
tiers.card: Lift what ten strong people could · break a door, chain or lock by touch · be heard 300 ft

tiers.text: Carry, push, or haul any load for 8 hours without tiring. Your word carries weight — advantage on Intimidation checks, and on Persuasion checks when you are making a demand rather than a request.
tiers.card: Haul any load 8 hrs untiring · advantage on Intimidation, and on Persuasion when demanding

tiers.text: Move something that should not be movable: a fallen pillar, a ship aground, a portcullis, a boulder blocking a pass. Shatter a nonmagical structure up to 20 feet across.
tiers.card: Move the immovable — a fallen pillar, a grounded ship, a portcullis · shatter 20 ft of structure

tiers.text: Reshape a landscape by will — divert a river, split a hill, raise or level ground across a mile. Or make one declaration that every creature who hears it knows, beyond doubt, you can enforce.
tiers.card: Reshape a landscape — divert a river, split a hill · or declare something everyone knows you can enforce

complementEffects.name: Unyielding Might
complementEffects.description: The primary effect lands with the weight of inevitability — dealing bonus force damage that ignores resistance and eventually knocks the target prone from sheer impact.

effect.text: On a hit or failed saving throw against the primary effect, the target takes bonus force damage equal to one damage die of the primary effect's type (minimum 1d6). This bonus damage ignores resistance.

upgrades.text: The bonus damage increases to two dice and also ignores damage reduction features such as Stoneskin or similar effects.
upgrades.card: +2 dice · also ignores damage reduction like Stoneskin

upgrades.text: The bonus damage increases to three dice, and the target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Verum DC or be knocked prone by the sheer force of impact.
upgrades.card: +3 dice · Str save {DC} or knocked prone

complementEffects.name: Unstoppable
complementEffects.description: A surge of power briefly makes an ally more than they are — granting speed, save bonuses, and eventually immunity to being Restrained or knocked prone.

effect.text: When the primary effect resolves, each of its targets gains +10 feet of speed and +1 to Strength and Constitution saving throws until the start of your next turn.
effect.card: The seal's targets: +10 ft speed and +1 to Str and Con saves until your next turn

upgrades.text: Level 5+: Each target also has advantage on Strength checks and may add your Verum Modifier to one damage roll before the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Advantage on Str checks · add {VM} to one damage roll

upgrades.text: Level 11+: Each target is also immune to being Restrained or knocked Prone until the start of your next turn.
upgrades.card: Can't be Restrained or knocked Prone

complementEffects.name: Domineer
complementEffects.description: The sheer weight of authority disrupts their next move — stripping their reaction and eventually preventing them from moving toward you at all.

effect.text: When the primary effect hits or a target fails their saving throw, that target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Verum DC or lose their reaction until the end of their next turn.
effect.card: Str save {DC} or they lose their reaction

upgrades.text: On a failed save, the target also has disadvantage on the first attack roll they make on their next turn.
upgrades.card: Fail also gives disadvantage on their first attack next turn

penalty.disadvantage: the first attack roll they make on their next turn

upgrades.text: Creatures that fail also cannot move toward you voluntarily until the end of their next turn — the dominance of the effect pressing them back.
upgrades.card: They also can't willingly move toward you
